t: Real Research Today: Ammonia Fuel Networks
title: Real Research Today: Ammonia Fuel Networks
definition: Today's documented research behind Ammonia Fuel Networks.
description:
The road to Ammonia Fuel Networks is already being paved. The US National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition (net energy gain) in December 2022. Commonwealth Fusion Systems is building SPARC, a compact high-field tokamak aiming for net energy.

Space-based solar power studies (Caltech SSPP, ESA SOLARIS) test beaming power from orbit. Together these programs form the cracker plants foundation that Ammonia Fuel Networks will build on — the network logistics results, the toxicity handling methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as network logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Ammonia Fuel Networks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Ammonia Fuel Networks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Ammonia Fuel Networks — ammonia as a shippable hydrogen carrier fuel.

Phase 1 — Prove (cracker plants): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (toxicity handling): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (port terminals): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and shipping-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
